witness.statement:
∀ (a u k m : Nat),
  instLENat.le 3 k →
    instLENat.le 1 a →
      instLENat.le a k →
        instLENat.le 1 u →
          instLENat.le u k →
            instLENat.le 1 m →
              instLENat.le m (instHSub.hSub k 2) →
                Or (instLENat.le a 1) (instLENat.le u 1) →
                  ∀ (side : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side) (left right : List ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter),
                    (∀ (x : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter),
                        List.instMembership.mem (instHAppendOfAppend.hAppend left right) x →
                          Or (Eq x ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.child)
                            (Eq x (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.ext 1 side))) →
                      have σ :=
                        { a := a, u := u, k := k,
                          word :=
                            instHAppendOfAppend.hAppend
                              (instHAppendOfAppend.hAppend left
                                (List.cons ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.child
                                  (List.cons ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.child List.nil)))
                              right,
                          maxima := List.cons m List.nil };
                      have ρ :=
                        { a := a, u := u, k := k,
                          word :=
                            instHAppendOfAppend.hAppend
                              (instHAppendOfAppend.hAppend left
                                (List.cons ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.child List.nil))
                              right,
                          maxima := List.cons m List.nil };
                      have opposite := fun s =>
                        ErdosSzekeres.ctx_one_level_root_singleton_base_exchange_unit_axis.match_1
                          (fun s => ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side) s
                          (fun _ => ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.upper) fun _ =>
                          ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side.lower;
                      instLENat.le 2 σ.numRuns →
                        ∀ (p : Nat),
                          List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions p →
                            ∀ (s : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side) (c : Nat),
                              instLENat.le 1 c →
                                instLENat.le c (instHSub.hSub k 2) →
                                  have q := ite (instLENat.le p left.length) p (instHSub.hSub p 1);
                                  Exists fun t =>
                                    Exists fun d =>
                                      And (instLENat.le 1 d)
                                        (And (instLENat.le d (instHSub.hSub k 2))
                                          (instLENat.le
                                            (instHAdd.hAdd
                                              (ErdosSzekeres.decomposableThreshold
                                                (instHAdd.hAdd
                                                  ((σ.part (List.cons p List.nil) s c).capLimit p p)
                                                  1)
                                                (instHAdd.hAdd
                                                  ((σ.part (List.cons p List.nil) s c).cupLimit p p)
                                                  1)
                                                k)
                                              (σ.part
                                                  (List.filter (fun r => Decidable.decide (Ne r p))
                                                    σ.childPositions)
                                                  (opposite s)
                                                  (instHSub.hSub (instHSub.hSub k 1) c)).bound)
                                            (instHAdd.hAdd
                                              (ErdosSzekeres.decomposableThreshold
                                                (instHAdd.hAdd
                                                  ((ρ.part (List.cons q List.nil) t d).capLimit q q)
                                                  1)
                                                (instHAdd.hAdd
                                                  ((ρ.part (List.cons q List.nil) t d).cupLimit q q)
                                                  1)
                                                k)
                                              (ρ.part
                                                  (List.filter (fun r => Decidable.decide (Ne r q))
                                                    ρ.childPositions)
                                                  (opposite t)
                                                  (instHSub.hSub (instHSub.hSub k 1) d)).bound)))
